claims: All five frozen artifact SHA-256 values and the prescribed LF-joined path:sha256 composite were independently recomputed from the artifact bytes and match the manifest.

The range is a genuine matched-depth probe: each of four families keeps identity and external evidence fixed while internal evidence nests from intake through work evidence to longitudinal correction, producing 12 profiles and 36 lifecycle inputs.

The care family advances a GBP 1.8 million six-district scheduling choice from a stop-rule question, through a data-versus-scheduling fault question, to a transferability test based on vulnerable-client continuity.

The research family advances a product shift that puts about GBP 900,000 of annual revenue at risk from identifying what clients uniquely pay for, through testing whether value survives without a senior researcher live, to an explicit renewal threshold for moving half the team.

The manufacturing family advances a GBP 4.2 million programme and redesign of 38 roles from a people-versus-system counterfactual, through a same-team plant test, to defining the customer-risk exceptions that must remain human-owned.

The entertainment family advances a GBP 18 million campaign allocation from naming the audience whose behaviour must change, through selecting an exposure-sequence test, to a fair-comparison ticket-intent threshold for releasing the investment.

The 36 lifecycle cases preserve consequential usefulness: profile-specific conflicts and corrections enter oracle-free inputs, while the task asks for one plain question only when its answer could change the route and the tests reject placeholder lifecycle notices.
